data.gender_notes: Wainwright is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old English words 'wagan' (wagon) and 'thryht' (power, strength). This name was given to someone who built and maintained roads for wagons, ensuring safe travel for communities. The name Wainwright carries the meaning “Wagon road builder” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Wainwright usually hope their child will grow to embody wagon road builder and live with faith, good character and purpose.
